O.outcome_detail: course dropout versus course passing across 2018–2022

cells.quote:
Table 1 shows the percentages of drop out, failure and pass by year of the subjects Introduction to Algebra (IA) and Introduction to Calculus (IC).
2018 IA 35% 30% 35%
2019 IA 30% 24% 46%
2020 IA 27% 7% 66%
2021 IA 20% 11% 69%
2022 IA 29% 17% 54%
cells.note: The study reports observational outcome percentages rather than an instructional treatment effect; columns are Drop out, Failure, and Pass.

O.outcome_detail: course failure versus course passing across 2018–2022

cells.quote:
Academic failure ranges between 31% and 66%, including both drop out and failure.
2018 IA 35% 30% 35%
2019 IA 30% 24% 46%
2020 IA 27% 7% 66%
2021 IA 20% 11% 69%
2022 IA 29% 17% 54%
cells.note: The study defines academic failure as including dropout and failure; the table separately reports the failure and pass percentages.
